wars.name: Napoleon's Italian campaign and San Marino (1797)
wars.outcome: No fighting: the advance of Napoleon's army in 1797 'presented a brief threat to the independence of San Marino'; the regent Antonio Onofri won Napoleon's respect, Napoleon promised 'to guarantee and protect the independence of the Republic' and offered to…

certainty.note: Monte Titano and the early community; the pages date only Chiesanuova (1320).
'Since then, the size of San Marino has remained unchanged' (History of San Marino, after the 1463 grants); the 1739-40 occupation by the legate of Ravenna did not change the borders.
